items.name: Front desk printer offline.txt
items.text:
If the front desk printer shows offline, power it off for ten seconds and back on. Then print a test page from the Contoso Dental front office workstation.

If it is still offline, check that the printer has the address that is printed on its network label.

items.name: Guest wifi password reset.md
items.text:
# Guest wifi

The waiting room guest network is rotated by the office manager. The technician changes it in the router console and tells the office manager through the help desk ticket, never by text message.

items.name: Nightly backup check.txt
items.text: Each morning the technician opens the backup console and confirms the overnight job for the practice server finished. A failed job is raised as a ticket the same day.
